style_prompt: Editorial-quality flowchart diagram, hand-drawn line work on warm off-white paper background (#F7F4ED). Two-tone palette of deep Alberta navy (#1A3A6E) for primary nodes and rust orange (#C2491A) for accents and arrows. Boxes have subtle shadows; labels in clean sans-serif; arrows are slightly curved with arrowheads. Architectural, calm, technical but human. Wide editorial aspect. No photo realism, no people, no logos, no watermarks. All text labels in English.
image_prompt: An editorial illustration of four review agents, one green, one amber-yellow, one rust-red, one navy-blue, working in concert and in balance around a single application as it passes through a checkpoint or gate. Each agent contributes its own check and the four combine into one verdict. A sense of harmonious checks and balances guarding one piece of work. Muted Alberta cream base with clear green, amber-yellow, rust-red, and navy-blue accents, archival print quality, no text, no logos.
